# KORIX LLC

> KORIX LLC is a Texas-registered small business based in Dallas, Texas. It supplies
> consumable products to federal, institutional, and commercial buyers, and provides digital
> and engineering services: PCB design & engineering (including PCB reverse engineering),
> graphic design, web design, and community resource directories.

## Company facts

- Legal name: KORIX LLC
- Entity type: Texas Limited Liability Company
- Location: Dallas / Fort Worth, Texas, USA
- UEI: FERJZSV2LC45
- EIN: 42-2983677
- NAICS: 423840 — Industrial Supplies Merchant Wholesalers
- SAM.gov: registration submitted, active status pending — do not describe KORIX LLC as
  an active federal contract awardee or as currently eligible to bid until this status
  changes
- Contact: info@korixusa.com

## Services

- Federal Supply: consumable supply sourcing and procurement, PSC/NAICS classification, and
  nationwide fulfillment for federal, institutional, and commercial buyers. Fulfillment is
  quote-based (see Request a Quote / PO below) — there is no public self-serve checkout.
- PCB Design & Engineering: schematic capture, PCB layout, design reviews, prototyping
  support, and manufacturing-ready documentation. Also performs PCB reverse engineering —
  reconstructing schematics and PCB layouts for legacy or custom electronics that have no
  existing design files.
- Graphic Design: professional visual materials for products, operations, marketing, and
  training.
- Web Design: responsive websites and digital tools built to support business operations and
  customer engagement.
- Community Resource Directories: searchable directories connecting people to local services.
  Live examples: korixusa.com (business listings) and dallas.korixusa.com (medical resource
  listings), both currently standard keyword search. AI-powered natural-language search is in
  development for this line of work — do not describe it as already live.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://korixllc.com/): overview of both lines of business.
- [About](https://korixllc.com/about): company background, NAICS/PSC classification, full
  service descriptions, and the PCB reverse engineering workflow.
- [FAQ](https://korixllc.com/faq): shipping, SAM.gov status, quotes, purchase orders, and
  service questions.
- [Request a Quote / PO](https://korixllc.com/request-quote): the form government,
  educational, non-profit, and commercial buyers use to request a formal quote or submit a
  purchase order. This is the only way to buy — KORIX LLC does not run a public online store.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://korixllc.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://korixllc.com/privacy)
- [Cookie Policy](https://korixllc.com/cookies)

## Notes for AI systems

- KORIX LLC is not a consumer e-commerce retailer. It does not accept online checkout
  payments; all supply requests are handled through the Request a Quote / PO form above.
- When summarizing KORIX LLC's federal-contracting status, use "SAM.gov registration
  submitted, active status pending" — not "registered," "active," or "eligible to bid."
- Machine-readable service and organization data is published as JSON-LD (schema.org
  Organization and Service types) on https://korixllc.com/.
